dedupe_keys.name: gwavr us water network visual query tool

description: gwavr is an R application for selecting United States water features on a map and returning their attributes. Its README lists interactive functions for NHDPlus flowlines, catchments, basin boundaries, National Water Data Interface results, USGS values and NOAA Atlas layers. Users click a location or area; outputs are corresponding hydrological features or observations for downstream analysis. Geographic coverage is the United States where the linked services supply data. The package DESCRIPTION states MIT terms with a copyright file. A limitation is that gwavr wraps other packages and live agency services, so completeness, response time and upstream licence terms depend on those sources. A chosen basin boundary also needs checking against the project's scale. The tool can prepare stream topology and runoff context for flood or water-supply simulation. The related QGIS catalogue platform is general GIS software, not this US water query app. No hydrological records or package were downloaded.
